title: Felix and the Terminal
author: Rosalind Brightwater
blurb: Edmund Brightwater, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
